name: What are common challenges in investment property renovations and how can they be avoided?

mainEntity.name: What are common challenges in investment property renovations and how can they be avoided?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges include unexpected structural issues, budget overruns, material delays, and scheduling conflicts. These can often be mitigated with thorough pre-renovation planning. Conduct a detailed inspection of the property to identify potential problems early. Establish a realistic budget that includes a contingency fund. Order materials well in advance and communicate regularly with your contractor about their availability. Maintain open and consistent communication with your contractor to address issues promptly and keep the project on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common renovation challenges like unexpected issues, budget overruns, and delays can be avoided with thorough planning, contingency funds, early material orders, and consistent communication with your contractor.
